conviction_note: Median reaction is 9.55% on 4-up-of-7 and realised vol is 58%, so the move will be large either way; the corpus gives one genuine asymmetry - the revenue line of this print was reaffirmed by the company on the last day of the quarter and the restructuring charge was pushed into the following quarter, while the stock fell 12.8% in the five sessions before the print with no filing and no news to explain it - which is worth about a third of the median, positive.

findings.finding: In the 8-K accepted 2026-07-31T21:28:25Z (items 2.05, 5.02, 7.01) ChargePoint reaffirmed Q2 revenue guidance of $100-110m for the quarter ending 2026-07-31 - i.e. on the final day of that quarter - and simultaneously disclosed a 10% workforce reduction with only ~$6m of restructuring cost that it expects to complete in Q3 FY2027, putting the charge in the next quarter rather than the one being reported, yet the stock fell 12.77% in the five sessions into the print with zero SEC filings in the whole of August 2026 and no captured news after 2026-08-27.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json accession 0001777393-26-000057 (form 8-K, items 2.05,5.02,7.01, accepted 2026-07-31T21:28:25Z, primary_document chpt-20260728.htm); the guidance-reaffirmation quote and the 10%/$6m figures are in docs/873be191fea4f318e7bcd6728893513945a3f67f.txt lines 142-148 (StockTwits sweep 20260830T083857Z)
findings.why_not_priced: Reaffirming revenue guidance on the last day of the quarter is close to a pre-announcement, and the restructuring cost being scheduled for Q3 means the reported quarter's cost base is unaffected. Nobody aggregated that: this name has 88 captured items of which 86 are EDGAR index rows, only one third-party post in the corpus noticed the reaffirmation at all, and there is no analyst preview, no consensus figure and no sell-side note anywhere in the capture. If the market had priced a de-risked revenue line and a deferred charge, the stock would not have lost 12.77% in five sessions on no filing and no news; instead the tape looks like generic small-cap EV-charging risk-off into an event.
findings.independence: A separate filing points the same way on the corporate-action axis rather than the P&L: the 8-K accepted 2026-06-30T20:32:30Z (accession 0001777393-26-000047, item 5.02) amended the CEO severance agreement to remove its termination date and extend it until the CEO's departure, https://www.rapidticker.com/news/chpt-sec-filing-d6f419 - which is the kind of housekeeping done ahead of a change of control and matches the corpus's heavy unsolicited M&A speculation, though on its own it is inference not evidence.

searched_and_found_nothing: any August 2026 filing: filings.json has none at all after 2026-07-31, so no ATM prospectus, no 424B, no new shelf and no Form 4 in the month before the print - the only S-3 and S-3/A in the index went effective in December 2025
a captured news body: the CHPT corpus holds no news documents, only three StockTwits blobs and 86 EDGAR rows, so no preview, no consensus EPS and no estimate revisions are visible
an explanation for the -12.77% five-day slide: no filing, no news item and no snapshot content after 2026-08-27
a Nasdaq listing or reverse-split issue: nothing in the filing index or the chatter
confirmation of the retail claim of 'high short interest, CEO buying' from a primary source - no Form 4 body is stored and there is no short-interest page in the capture

the identity or substance of the item 5.02 change bundled into the 2026-07-31 8-K, and of the separate item 5.02 8-Ks on 2026-04-17 and 2026-06-30 - three officer/director changes in four months is notable churn but no body is stored for any of them
baseline_tension: It cuts against the run-up: the tape was down 12.8% in five days and 10.7% in twenty, and the finding says the reported quarter's revenue was already committed and its cost base protected, so the pre-print selling looks uninformed rather than informed.
corpus_limits: No option chain or skew. No stored body for any 8-K, so the guidance-reaffirmation language and the 10%/$6m restructuring figures reach me second-hand through a rapidticker summary quoted in a StockTwits post rather than from the filing itself - the filing's existence, form, items and acceptance time are primary from filings.json, but the numbers inside it are not. No news coverage of any kind was captured, so I cannot say what consensus for the quarter was or whether the Q3 guide is the real driver. No contaminated documents were found (all six snapshots carry tripwires: null).
